items.title: What is EIP-7702? The Ethereum Upgrade Behind the $6.4B Binance Hack
items.body: EIP-7702 lets ordinary Ethereum wallets run smart contract code, enabling batched and sponsored transactions. Here's how it works.

items.title: Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
items.body: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.

items.title: Binance Hacker Hunts for Exit Ramps as DeFi Exchanges Pause Markets
items.body: Etherscan records show wallets tied to the suspected Binance hack swapping freezable stablecoins for Ethereum on decentralized exchanges.
